raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misstated Charlemagne’s reign as 742–814 (those are his birth–death years; his reign was 768–814). This factual error was the first mistake and introduced timeline confusion (later compounded by the anachronistic “around 860” remark), even though the final language identification remained Latin.
